conditionForCurveDiscrimination: Endpoint signatures are original resource facts. Render masks, blending, provider ownership, native start/state and source phase are not established; numeric eye values are not measured source pixels. Thus conditional incompatibilities are not blanket exclusions.
usefulDiscriminators: face_bikkuri closes at0.167, adds both wrinkles by0.333, terminal eye1.3/mouth1/Z-4.
face_ikaru closes0.333..0.4 then eye0.827 and Z14;02/03 delay wrinkle onset to1.733/1.367 and share terminal values.
face_ikaru_hai starts wrinkle1, closes0.667..0.733, ends eye1/mouth1/Z0 and Y-29.
face_uru/uru_kuzu close0.233..0.667 and end eye1/1.2 with mouth0.9/1; kanrui/kandou share wrinkles but terminal mouth0.
face_syosou has wide eyes/wrinkles and mouth1 but no closed-eye endpoint in its own resource; an independent blink/provider could still close the eye.
face_zetsubou terminalZ-19 and mouth0.5; face_egao_kuzu eye0.5/Z9. No visual exclusion is final without isolated original-model painting.

proposedMinimumNextEvidence.firstComparison: One full-entry face-only original-model control for face_bikkuri with body kept empty/default, preserving ordinary3→4→5 and complete typing+hold/exit. This tests the wide-eye/forehead/large-mouth sequence rather than a still.
proposedMinimumNextEvidence.secondOrthogonalComparator: A face-only face_ikaru_hai control on the same unchanged body if a two-case release is authorized: it separates always-present wrinkle/Z0/eye1 from bikkuri wrinkle ramp/Z-4/eye1.3.
proposedMinimumNextEvidence.whyNoAllFamiliesCaptureNow: The current baseline plus all-resource curve survey can choose a small discriminating next comparison, but cannot certify the winner or trigger a renderer run. Remaining variants stay explicit.
proposedMinimumNextEvidence.neededBindings: Exact original model/clip/controller bytes, actual ordinary input fields, full source+candidate native frame coverage, owner/layer/curve archive and independent producer closure. PreGL data cannot replace painted-frame review.
proposedMinimumNextEvidence.bodyFieldNext: Keep native motion empty for baseline. No act token is justified solely by visible low arms or a face match; body-only comparison would be separately scoped if a torso/arm mismatch becomes measurable.
